body:
Looking at the current state of the ASVS I noticed, that there are few, if any, requirements regarding containers (e.g. docker and friends) and orchestrators. NIST has published a guidance document (sp800-190) for securing such technologies. CIS has also a couple of documents on these topics. 

Is there any interest in having container-specific requirements/verification statements as part of this document? I could make a pull request if it were so.
